title: Prevalence, causes, and predictors of 30-day readmissions after acute myocardial infarction with ventricular arrhythmias: a cohort study using the 2016-2017 national readmissions database.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Patients surviving acute myocardial infarction (AMI) complicated by ventricular arrhythmias (VAs) are at high risk of early post-discharge readmissions due to multiple complications. These readmissions worsen clinical outcomes and add substantial financial strain to the U.S. healthcare system. This study investigates the prevalence, causes, and predictors of 30-day readmissions following hospitalization for AMI complicated by VAs.

METHODS AND RESULTS: Hospitalizations for AMI complicated by VAs were identified from the 2016-2017 Nationwide Readmissions Database. Independent predictors of 30-day readmission were analyzed using multivariable survey-weighted logistic regression in the R statistical software (version 4.5.0). Among 93 588 index hospitalizations, 8154 (8.7%) resulted in 30-day readmissions. In-hospital mortality occurred in 16.43% of index admissions and 5.92% of readmissions. Significant predictors of readmission included older age (OR: 1.01; P < 0.001), female sex (OR: 1.13; P = 0.002), prior heart failure (OR: 1.28; P < 0.001), peripheral vascular disease (OR: 1.18; P = 0.002), COPD (OR: 1.43; P < 0.001), atrial fibrillation (OR: 1.24; P < 0.001), diabetes (OR: 1.29; P < 0.001), previous MI (OR: 1.12; P = 0.009), end-stage renal disease (ESRD) (OR: 1.52; P < 0.001), stroke (OR: 1.52; P < 0.001), and hospital stay >4 days (OR: 1.94; P < 0.001). Higher income quartiles were associated with lower readmission risk. The mean index charges were $151 722, whereas charges per readmission were $64 122.

CONCLUSIONS: AMI complicated by VAs is associated with high 30-day readmission rates, driven mainly by noncardiac and select cardiac causes such as heart failure and atrial fibrillation. Enhanced monitoring of high-risk groups may improve outcomes and reduce healthcare costs.

AI.tldr: 在因急性心肌梗死合并室性心律失常住院的患者中，30天再入院率为8.7%，主要预测因素包括终末期肾病、卒中、住院超过4天及COPD等合并症。
AI.motivation: 急性心肌梗死（AMI）合并室性心律失常（VAs）的幸存者出院后早期再入院风险高，但关于其30天再入院的患病率、原因及预测因素的大样本数据有限。本研究旨在利用全国再入院数据库填补这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 基于2016-2017年美国全国再入院数据库（Nationwide Readmissions Database）的回顾性队列研究。纳入因AMI合并VAs住院的病例，共93 588例索引住院。主要终点为30天再入院。采用多变量调查加权logistic回归分析再入院的独立预测因素，使用R软件（版本4.5.0）进行统计。
AI.result: 93 588例索引住院中，8 154例（8.7%）发生30天再入院。索引住院死亡率为16.43%，再入院死亡率为5.92%。再入院的显著预测因素包括：年龄较大（OR 1.01，P<0.001）、女性（OR 1.13，P=0.002）、既往心力衰竭（OR 1.28，P<0.001）、外周血管疾病（OR 1.18，P=0.002）、COPD（OR 1.43，P<0.001）、心房颤动（OR 1.24，P<0.001）、糖尿病（OR 1.29，P<0.001）、既往心肌梗死（OR 1.12，P=0.009）、终末期肾病（OR 1.52，P<0.001）、卒中（OR 1.52，P<0.001）及住院时间>4天（OR 1.94，P<0.001）。较高收入四分位数与较低再入院风险相关。索引住院平均费用为151 722美元，每次再入院费用为64 122美元。
AI.conclusion: AMI合并VAs患者30天再入院率高，主要由非心脏原因及部分心脏原因（如心力衰竭和心房颤动）驱动。加强对高危人群的监测可能改善预后并降低医疗费用。本研究为观察性设计，仅能提示关联，不能推断因果；且缺乏再入院具体原因的分类数据。

title: Management of Post-heart Transplant Atrial Fibrillation.
summary: AF is the most common atrial arrhythmia encountered after orthotopic heart transplantation, with distinct pathophysiology and clinical implications. While early postoperative AF is typically transient, late-onset AF is increasingly recognised as a marker of graft dysfunction, rejection or vasculopathy. Risk factors include advanced recipient age, prolonged ischaemic time and immunosuppressive therapy. The denervated status of the transplanted heart alters typical electrophysiology, complicating diagnosis and management. Management requires individualised strategies balancing rate versus rhythm control, careful drug interaction monitoring and thromboembolic risk assessment. Emerging evidence supports catheter ablation in select cases, although data remain limited. Immunosuppressants, particularly calcineurin inhibitors and azathioprine, may increase AF susceptibility. Given the lack of transplant-specific AF guidelines, a multidisciplinary approach is essential. Improved understanding of AF in orthotopic heart transplantation is critical to optimising graft longevity and patient survival. Future studies are needed to guide evidence-based management and surveillance.

AI.tldr: 心脏移植后房颤常见，早期多为一过性，晚期提示移植物功能障碍或排斥，管理需个体化并多学科协作。
AI.motivation: 心脏移植后房颤具有独特的病理生理和临床意义，但缺乏移植特异性指南，既往证据有限，需明确其管理策略以优化移植物存活和患者生存。
AI.method: 本文为综述，总结心脏移植后房颤的病理生理、危险因素、诊断和管理，包括速率与节律控制、药物相互作用、血栓栓塞风险评估及导管消融的 emerging 证据。摘要未报告系统评价方法或样本量。
AI.result: 早期术后房颤通常为一过性，晚期房颤日益被认为是移植物功能障碍、排斥或血管病的标志。危险因素包括受者年龄较大、缺血时间延长和免疫抑制治疗。移植心脏去神经状态改变典型电生理，使诊断和管理复杂化。免疫抑制剂（尤其钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂和硫唑嘌呤）可能增加房颤易感性。新兴证据支持选择性病例行导管消融，但数据仍有限。摘要未报告具体效应量或统计值。
AI.conclusion: 心脏移植后房颤管理需个体化策略，平衡速率与节律控制，监测药物相互作用并评估血栓栓塞风险，多学科方法至关重要。未来需研究指导循证管理和监测，以改善移植物长期存活和患者生存。

title: Hybrid high-power short-duration ablation for atrial fibrillation: a meta-analysis
summary: High-power short-duration (HPSD) radiofrequency ablation, including very-high-power short-duration (vHPSD) and Ablation Index (AI)-guided approaches, has emerged for pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) in atrial fibrillation (AF). A hybrid strategy combining posterior vHPSD with anterior AI-guided ablation has been proposed to leverage the theoretical advantages of each, but its comparative effectiveness remains unclear. This meta-analysis aimed to assess the efficacy, safety, and procedural efficiency of the hybrid ablation strategy compared to vHPSD-only or AI-guided-only approaches for AF. A systematic search of multiple databases was conducted up to June 2026 for studies comparing the hybrid strategy (posterior vHPSD+anterior AI-guided) against uniform control strategies (vHPSD-only or AI-guided-only). Pooled odds ratios (ORs) and mean differences (MDs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated. Eight studies ( n = 2,771 patients) were included. In stratified analyses, the hybrid strategy demonstrated comparable 12-month freedom from atrial arrhythmia to both vHPSD-only (OR 0.97; 95% CI 0.76 − 1.26; P = 0.84) and AI-guided-only (OR 1.06; 95% CI 0.54 − 2.09; P = 0.87) approaches, with similarly low complication rates (vs. vHPSD: OR 1.62, 95% CI 0.79 − 3.29; vs. AI-guided: OR 0.43, 95% CI 0.08 − 2.41). First-pass PVI rates were numerically higher versus vHPSD-only (OR 1.26; 95% CI 0.92 − 1.73; P = 0.15) but not versus AI-guided-only (OR 1.22; 95% CI 0.66 − 2.27; P = 0.53). Ablation duration was longer than vHPSD-only (MD 7.95 min, 95% CI 7.15 − 8.75, P < 0.00001) but shorter than AI-guided-only (MD − 2.00 min, 95% CI − 3.11 to − 0.89, P = 0.0004). Total procedure time was not conclusively longer than vHPSD-only (MD 13.28 min, 95% CI 1.22 − 25.34, P = 0.03, not-robust in sensitivity analysis) but comparable to AI-guided-only (MD 3.18 min, 95% CI − 12.42 to 18.77, P = 0.69). This review was not prospectively registered. Certainty of evidence is limited by the predominance of observational studies and heterogeneity in control group definitions. The hybrid strategy demonstrated comparable 12-month efficacy and safety versus uniform approaches, without superiority in any endpoint. A numerically higher first-pass PVI rate versus vHPSD-only was a hypothesis-generating surrogate finding. Ablation time was intermediate. The hybrid approach represents an anatomically informed alternative, but superiority over uniform strategies remains unproven.

AI.tldr: 混合消融策略（后壁vHPSD+前壁AI引导）与单纯vHPSD或单纯AI引导相比，12个月无房性心律失常率及并发症率相当，无任何终点显示优效。
AI.motivation: 高功率短时程（HPSD）射频消融用于房颤肺静脉隔离（PVI）已发展出vHPSD与AI引导两种模式。有学者提出后壁vHPSD联合前壁AI引导的混合策略，理论上可兼顾两者优势，但其相对有效性尚不明确，缺乏系统评价。
AI.method: 系统综述与meta分析，检索多个数据库至2026年6月，纳入比较混合策略（后壁vHPSD+前壁AI引导）与统一对照策略（单纯vHPSD或单纯AI引导）的研究。合并计算OR与均数差（MD）及95%CI。共纳入8项研究、2771例患者。主要终点为12个月无房性心律失常，次要终点包括并发症、首次PVI通过率、消融时间及总手术时间。本研究未前瞻性注册。
AI.result: 混合策略12个月无房性心律失常率与单纯vHPSD相当（OR 0.97，95%CI 0.76–1.26，P=0.84），与单纯AI引导亦相当（OR 1.06，95%CI 0.54–2.09，P=0.87）；并发症率同样无差异（vs vHPSD：OR 1.62，95%CI 0.79–3.29；vs AI引导：OR 0.43，95%CI 0.08–2.41）。首次PVI通过率较单纯vHPSD数值上更高但无统计学意义（OR 1.26，95%CI 0.92–1.73，P=0.15），与单纯AI引导无差异（OR 1.22，95%CI 0.66–2.27，P=0.53）。消融时间较单纯vHPSD更长（MD 7.95 min，95%CI 7.15–8.75，P<0.00001），较单纯AI引导更短（MD −2.00 min，95%CI −3.11至−0.89，P=0.0004）。总手术时间较单纯vHPSD的延长在敏感性分析中不稳健（MD 13.28 min，95%CI 1.22–25.34，P=0.03），与单纯AI引导相当（MD 3.18 min，95%CI −12.42至18.77，P=0.69）。
AI.conclusion: 混合消融策略在12个月疗效与安全性上与统一策略相当，但未在任何终点显示优效；首次PVI通过率数值上的优势仅为假设生成性替代指标。消融时间介于两种统一策略之间。该策略可作为一种基于解剖分区的替代选择，但证据以观察性研究为主、对照组定义异质，尚不能证明其优于统一策略，需随机对照试验验证。

title: Regional E/e′ index on echocardiography predicts atrial fibrillation recurrence following catheter ablation
summary: Abstract Background The discriminative accuracy of regional E/e′ indexes has yet to be clearly established in predicting atrial fibrillation (AF) recurrence following catheter ablation. Few studies have proposed and validated a clinically useful threshold of regional E/e′ ratios for predicting recurrence after ablation. Hence, we sought to perform a comprehensive analysis of regional E/e′ ratios for predicting AF recurrence after the procedure. Methods Data were retrospectively screened from 784 patients with nonvalvular AF. The incidence of AF recurrence was recorded during the follow-up period of 36 months after the procedure. Regional E/e′ ratios on echocardiography were obtained and analyzed to assess the association with recurrence. Results The follow-up rate reached 98.6% with the mean follow-up period was 32.2 ± 0.3 months. Of 784 patients beyond the first three months blanking period, 209 (26.7%) cases experienced AF recurrence. The lateral E/e′ ratio was higher in patients with AF recurrence compared to those with maintenance of sinus rhythm together with septal E/e′ ratio. There was no collinearity between the two regional E/e′ ratios. It was identified that the lateral E/e′ ratio appeared an incremental discriminatory performance with an optimal cut-off value ≥ 10.8 to predict AF recurrence. Further analysis confirmed the lateral E/e′ ratio as an independent predictor of the postprocedural recurrence. Conclusion The lateral E/e′ ratio might have superiority over septal E/e′ ratio as a valuable predictor for AF recurrence following ablation. Furthermore, the lateral E/e′ ratio ≥ 10.8 appeared a good discriminatory performance in predicting recurrence after the therapeutic intervention. Clinical trial number Not applicable.

AI.tldr: 在784例非瓣膜性房颤消融患者中，侧壁E/e′比值≥10.8可独立预测术后房颤复发，其判别效能优于室间隔E/e′。
AI.motivation: 区域E/e′比值预测房颤消融术后复发的判别准确性尚不明确，缺乏经过验证的临床可用阈值，因此本研究旨在全面分析区域E/e′比值与术后复发的关系。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入784例非瓣膜性房颤患者，术后随访36个月，记录空白期（3个月）后房颤复发情况。获取超声心动图侧壁和室间隔E/e′比值，分析其与复发的关联。主要终点为术后房颤复发。统计方法包括组间比较、共线性分析、判别效能评估（确定最佳截断值）及多因素回归分析独立预测因子。
AI.result: 随访率98.6%，平均随访32.2±0.3个月。209例（26.7%）出现房颤复发。复发组侧壁E/e′比值高于窦性心律维持组，室间隔E/e′比值亦较高。两区域E/e′比值间无共线性。侧壁E/e′比值预测复发的最佳截断值为≥10.8，具有增量判别效能。进一步分析证实侧壁E/e′比值是术后复发的独立预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 侧壁E/e′比值可能优于室间隔E/e′比值，是预测房颤消融术后复发的有价值指标；侧壁E/e′≥10.8对预测复发具有良好的判别效能。该指标有助于术前风险分层，但研究为回顾性单中心设计，结论需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
摘要

背景：区域E/e′指数的判别准确性在预测导管消融术后心房颤动（AF）复发方面尚未明确建立。很少有研究提出并验证用于预测消融术后复发的区域E/e′比值的临床有用阈值。因此，我们试图对区域E/e′比值预测术后AF复发进行全面分析。

方法：回顾性筛选了784例非瓣膜性AF患者的数据。在术后36个月的随访期内记录AF复发的发生率。获取并分析超声心动图上的区域E/e′比值，以评估与复发的关联。

结果：随访率达到98.6%，平均随访期为32.2 ± 0.3个月。在首次三个月空白期后的784例患者中，209例（26.7%）经历了AF复发。与维持窦性心律的患者相比，AF复发患者的侧壁E/e′比值较高，同时室间隔E/e′比值也较高。两个区域E/e′比值之间不存在共线性。研究发现，侧壁E/e′比值表现出增量判别性能，预测AF复发的最佳截断值≥ 10.8。进一步分析证实侧壁E/e′比值是术后复发的独立预测因子。

结论：侧壁E/e′比值可能优于室间隔E/e′比值，作为消融术后AF复发的有价值预测因子。此外，侧壁E/e′比值≥ 10.8在预测治疗干预后复发方面表现出良好的判别性能。

title: Efficacy and safety of perioperative colchicine for prevention of postoperative atrial fibrillation after thoracic cardiac and non-cardiac surgery: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis
summary: Given the anti-inflammatory properties of colchicine, its role in preventing Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of perioperative colchicine in patients undergoing cardiac and non-cardiac surgery. A systematic search of PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science was performed up to 2 May 2026. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and comparative observational studies with adjusted analyses (e.g., propensity-score matched cohorts) comparing colchicine with standard care or placebo were eligible for inclusion. Risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were pooled using a random-effects model. Subgroup, sensitivity analysis, publication bias, and meta-regression analyses were performed. Thirteen studies involving 5,529 patients (49.79% receiving colchicine) were included. The colchicine group demonstrated a non-significant reduction in the overall risk of POAF compared with the control group (RR: 0.80, 95% CI: 0.63–1.02; p = 0.07). Although patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) experienced a significant reduction in POAF risk (RR: 0.72, 95% CI: 0.55–0.95; p = 0.02), no significant effect was observed in cardiac non-CABG surgeries (RR: 1.24, 95% CI: 0.77–2.02; p = 0.38) or non-cardiac surgeries (RR: 0.90, 95% CI: 0.50–1.63; p = 0.73). Colchicine did not significantly affect all-cause mortality, hospital length of stay, postoperative myocardial infarction, stroke or transient ischemic attack, post-pericardiotomy syndrome, or myocardial injury after non-cardiac surgery compared with the control group (all p > 0.05). Colchicine was associated with a significantly higher risk of discontinuation due to adverse events (RR: 1.33, 95% CI: 1.14–1.54; p < 0.01), serious adverse events (RR: 1.63, 95% CI: 1.02–2.59; p = 0.04), gastrointestinal complications (RR: 2.30, 95% CI: 1.43–3.69; p < 0.01), and diarrhea (RR: 3.24, 95% CI: 2.48–4.24; p < 0.01). These safety signals were driven primarily by gastrointestinal intolerance and treatment discontinuation; the serious-adverse-event estimate was based on relatively sparse events and should be interpreted cautiously. Although the primary analysis did not demonstrate a statistically significant reduction in POAF with perioperative colchicine, exploratory subgroup analysis suggested a significant reduction in POAF among patients undergoing CABG. However, this finding should be interpreted cautiously because the between-group difference across surgery types was not statistically significant ( p = 0.15). Colchicine was associated with increased gastrointestinal adverse events, diarrhea, and treatment discontinuation; the observed serious-adverse-event signal should be interpreted cautiously because of sparse events. Any potential benefit in the CABG-containing cardiac subgroup should therefore be weighed against the treatment’s tolerability profile.

title: LAA occluder device impeding pulsed field ablation of an anterior mitral line: a case report about the role of a dual energy source.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) and percutaneous closure of the left atrial appendage are increasingly used in patients with atrial fibrillation. An interaction between this form of energy and metallic structures in the heart is an emerging problem. We first report a left atrial appendage closure (LAAC)-limiting PFA using a novel dual energy ablation catheter, solved by switching to the classic radiofrequency ablation.

CASE SUMMARY: An 85-year-old woman with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and a history of persistent atrial fibrillation (status post pulmonary vein isolation in 2019, with a 25 mm Abbott Amulet LAAC implanted in 2023) presented with recurrent atrial tachycardia. During redo ablation, mapping revealed a macroreentrant circuit through an anterior left atrial low-voltage area. While extending a linear PFA lesion towards the LAAC, the generator repeatedly aborted applications due to invalid impedance values near the device-despite the device having been in place for 3 years. Switching to radiofrequency energy on the same catheter allowed the line to be completed successfully, achieving bidirectional block and tachycardia non-inducibility.

DISCUSSION: The interaction between PFA and metallic cardiac devices may limit catheter ablation, a problem that can be solved by technologies that allow for the switch to radiofrequency sources. Dual energy technologies may be therefore preferred in patients with LAAC devices.

AI.tldr: 85岁持续性房颤患者，LAAC装置植入3年后行PFA消融时因阻抗无效反复中止，改用双能量导管射频能量完成二尖瓣前线性消融并实现双向阻滞。
AI.motivation: PFA与LAAC在房颤患者中应用日益广泛，PFA能量与心脏金属结构的相互作用是新兴临床问题，既往缺乏LAAC装置限制PFA消融的报道。
AI.method: 病例报告。85岁女性，HFpEF，持续性房颤，2019年PVI，2023年植入25 mm Abbott Amulet LAAC，因复发房速行再次消融。三维电解剖标测显示经左房前壁低电压区的宏折返环，拟用新型双能量导管行PFA线性消融延伸至LAAC。
AI.result: PFA消融靠近LAAC装置时，因阻抗值无效，发生器反复中止放电，尽管装置已植入3年。同一导管切换至射频能量后成功完成线性消融，实现双向阻滞，房速不可诱发。
AI.conclusion: PFA与金属心脏装置的相互作用可能限制导管消融，双能量技术可切换至射频能量解决该问题，因此LAAC装置患者可能优先选择双能量消融技术。

summary_zh:
背景：脉冲场消融（PFA）和经皮左心耳封堵在心房颤动患者中的应用日益增多。这种能量形式与心脏内金属结构之间的相互作用是一个新出现的问题。我们首次报告了一例使用新型双能量消融导管进行的左心耳封堵（LAAC）限制性PFA，通过转换为经典射频消融得以解决。

病例摘要：一位85岁女性，患有射血分数保留的心力衰竭，有持续性心房颤动病史（2019年肺静脉隔离术后状态，2023年植入25 mm Abbott Amulet LAAC装置），因复发性房性心动过速就诊。在再次消融过程中，标测显示通过左心房前壁低电压区的大折返环路。在将线性PFA损伤向LAAC延伸时，尽管该装置已植入3年，发生器因装置附近阻抗值无效而反复中止放电。在同一导管上转换为射频能量后，成功完成了消融线，实现了双向阻滞和心动过速不可诱发。

讨论：PFA与金属心脏装置之间的相互作用可能限制导管消融，这一问题可通过允许转换为射频源的技术来解决。因此，在植入LAAC装置的患者中，双能量技术可能更受青睐。

title: Development of an efficient deep learning model for arrhythmia detection from consumer smartwatches.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Cardiac arrhythmias often progress without clear symptoms and may remain undetected until severe complications occur. Continuous monitoring through consumer smartwatches offers a scalable and non-invasive opportunity for real-time rhythm screening in free-living conditions. However, wrist-based photoplethysmography (PPG) signals are highly susceptible to motion artifacts and inter-subject variability, limiting traditional signal-processing techniques. In this work, we compare classical machine learning and deep learning approaches for multi-class arrhythmia classification from real-life smartwatch PPG and accelerometer recordings collected in the Pulsewatch clinical trial. Three rhythm categories are considered: normal sinus rhythm (NSR), atrial fibrillation (AF), and premature atrial or ventricular contractions (PAC/PVC).

METHODS: The evaluated approaches include a Random Forest classifier based on engineered temporal and morphological features, together with two end-to-end architectures, CNN-GRU and CNN-BiLSTM, designed to learn temporal patterns directly from raw two-channel smartwatch waveforms while addressing motion artifacts, sensor noise, and cross-subject generalization.

RESULTS: Under two-fold subject-independent cross-validation, the Random Forest achieved the highest average accuracy among the proposed methods (91.22%), together with the best macro precision (85.89%), macro F1 score (84.17%), and macro ROC-AUC (97.03%). The CNN-BiLSTM achieved the highest macro recall (87.37%), indicating stronger sensitivity to arrhythmic classes, while the CNN-GRU remained competitive with a macro recall of 86.85% and a macro F1 score of 83.13%.

DISCUSSION: Compared with the Pulsewatch baselines reported by Han et al., the proposed methods improved the available macro-level metrics, with the Random Forest obtaining the strongest macro precision and macro F1 score and the CNN-BiLSTM the strongest macro recall, indicating improved class-balanced recognition of clinically relevant arrhythmic events. These results show that feature-based models remain highly competitive for smartwatch-based arrhythmia detection, achieving the strongest overall and macro F1 performance among the proposed methods, while hybrid convolutional-recurrent architectures provide increased sensitivity to minority rhythm classes. Deployment-oriented profiling under an identical single-core benchmark showed a mean end-to-end inference time of 33.08 ms for the Random Forest pipeline and 51.87 ms for the CNN-BiLSTM model on a 30-s segment, supporting near-real-time rhythm screening.

CONCLUSION: Overall, this work highlights the trade-offs between the analyzed approaches in terms of accuracy, class-balanced performance, computational complexity, and deployment feasibility for wearable cardiac monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 在Pulsewatch试验的真实智能手表PPG和加速度数据中，随机森林对NSR、AF和PAC/PVC三分类的总体准确率最高（91.22%），而CNN-BiLSTM对心律失常类的召回率最高（87.37%）。
AI.motivation: 心律失常常无症状，消费级智能手表为自由生活条件下的连续节律筛查提供了可扩展的无创手段，但腕部PPG信号易受运动伪影和个体差异影响，传统信号处理技术受限；既往缺乏对经典机器学习与深度学习在多类心律失常分类中的系统比较。
AI.method: 基于Pulsewatch临床试验的真实智能手表PPG和加速度双通道记录，比较三种方法进行NSR、AF和PAC/PVC三分类：基于手工时序与形态学特征的随机森林，以及直接从原始波形端到端学习的CNN-GRU和CNN-BiLSTM；采用两折受试者独立交叉验证，评估准确率、宏精确率、宏召回率、宏F1和宏ROC-AUC。
AI.result: 随机森林平均准确率最高（91.22%），宏精确率85.89%、宏F1 84.17%、宏ROC-AUC 97.03%均为最优；CNN-BiLSTM宏召回率最高（87.37%），CNN-GRU宏召回率86.85%、宏F1 83.13%。与Han等报道的Pulsewatch基线相比，所提方法在宏指标上均有提升；单核基准下30秒片段平均端到端推理时间随机森林为33.08 ms、CNN-BiLSTM为51.87 ms。
AI.conclusion: 基于特征工程的随机森林在智能手表心律失常检测中总体及宏F1表现最强，混合卷积-循环架构对少数心律失常类敏感性更高；两类方法在准确率、类别均衡性能、计算复杂度和部署可行性上各有取舍，支持近实时节律筛查，但结论受限于两折交叉验证及单一试验数据，需外部验证。

summary_zh:
引言：心脏心律失常通常进展时无明显症状，可能直至严重并发症发生才被发现。通过消费级智能手表进行连续监测，为自由生活条件下的实时节律筛查提供了一种可扩展且无创的机会。然而，基于腕部的光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号极易受到运动伪影和受试者间变异性的影响，限制了传统信号处理技术的应用。在本研究中，我们比较了经典机器学习与深度学习方法，用于对Pulsewatch临床试验中采集的真实智能手表PPG和加速度计记录进行多类心律失常分类。考虑了三种节律类别：正常窦性心律（NSR）、心房颤动（AF）以及房性或室性期前收缩（PAC/PVC）。

方法：评估的方法包括基于工程化时间与形态学特征的随机森林分类器，以及两种端到端架构CNN-GRU和CNN-BiLSTM，后者设计为直接从原始双通道智能手表波形中学习时间模式，同时处理运动伪影、传感器噪声和跨受试者泛化问题。

结果：在两折受试者独立交叉验证下，随机森林在所提方法中取得了最高的平均准确率（91.22%），以及最佳的宏精确率（85.89%）、宏F1分数（84.17%）和宏ROC-AUC（97.03%）。CNN-BiLSTM取得了最高的宏召回率（87.37%），表明对心律失常类别具有更强的敏感性，而CNN-GRU保持竞争力，宏召回率为86.85%，宏F1分数为83.13%。

讨论：与Han等人报告的Pulsewatch基线相比，所提方法改善了可用的宏级指标，其中随机森林获得了最强的宏精确率和宏F1分数，CNN-BiLSTM获得了最强的宏召回率，表明对临床相关心律失常事件的类别平衡识别有所改善。这些结果表明，基于特征的模型在基于智能手表的心律失常检测中仍具有高度竞争力，在所提方法中取得了最强的整体和宏F1性能，而混合卷积-循环架构对少数节律类别提供了更高的敏感性。在相同单核基准下的面向部署分析显示，对于30秒片段，随机森林流程的平均端到端推理时间为33.08毫秒，CNN-BiLSTM模型为51.87毫秒，支持近实时节律筛查。

结论：总体而言，本研究突出了所分析方法在可穿戴心脏监测系统的准确性、类别平衡性能、计算复杂度和部署可行性方面的权衡。

title: Factors associated with short- and long-term maintenance of sinus rhythm after successful elective electrical cardioversion
summary: Introduction Electrical cardioversion (ECV) effectively restores sinus rhythm in patients with persistent atrial fibrillation (AF) and atrial flutter (AFL), although arrhythmia recurrence is common. We aimed to identify factors associated with a higher probability of maintaining sinus rhythm one month after successful ECV, and after one year in those who were arrhythmia-free after the first month. Methods This retrospective, single-center study included patients who underwent elective ECV for persistent AF or AFL between January 2011 and June 2023. Clinical, electrocardiographic, and echocardiographic characteristics were analyzed to identify parameters associated with the maintenance of sinus rhythm. Results We included 297 ECV procedures. ECV was successful in 91.9% of patients and sinus rhythm was maintained in 89.7% of them at one month and in 40.3% at one year follow-up. Shorter arrhythmia duration (OR = 0.863, 95% CI: 0.76–0.98, p = 0.026) and ventricular pacing on the pre-procedural ECG (OR = 5.212, 95% CI: 1.16–23.48, p = 0.032) were associated with one-month success. Factors associated with one-year sinus rhythm maintenance in patients who were in sinus rhythm during monthly follow-up were smaller left atrial dimensions (OR = 0.817, 95%CI: 0.77–0.98, p = 0.022), the first-ever arrhythmia episode (OR = 3.320, 95%CI: 1.10–10.05, p = 0.034), lower CHA 2 DS 2 -VASc score (OR = 0.132, 95%CI: 0.03–0.54, p = 0.005), non-smoking status (OR = 0.120, 95%CI: 0.04–0.37, p < 0.001), no previous ECV (OR = 0.082, 95%CI: 0.01–0.47, p = 0.005), and antiarrhythmic therapy (OR = 2.486, 95%CI: 1.01–8.65, p = 0.05). Conclusions ECV is a reasonable rhythm-control strategy in AF/AFL particularly when performed early after arrhythmia onset, in non-smokers and patients with fewer comorbidities, antiarrhythmic treatment, smaller left atrium and no prior ECV.

AI.tldr: 择期电复律成功恢复窦性心律后，1个月维持率89.7%，1年降至40.3%；早期复律、非吸烟、低CHA2DS2-VASc、小左房及抗心律失常治疗与维持窦律相关。
AI.motivation: 持续性房颤/房扑患者电复律后心律失常复发常见，既往证据对短期和长期窦律维持的预测因素缺乏系统描述，本研究旨在识别与复律后1个月及1年窦律维持相关的临床、心电图和超声心动图因素。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2011年1月至2023年6月因持续性AF或AFL接受择期电复律的患者，共297例次操作。分析临床、心电图及超声心动图特征，以复律后1个月及1年窦律维持为终点，采用多因素回归分析识别相关因素。
AI.conclusion: 电复律是AF/AFL合理的节律控制策略，尤其在心律失常早期、非吸烟、合并症少、接受抗心律失常治疗、左房较小且无既往电复律史的患者中维持窦律概率更高。本研究为单中心回顾性设计，结论需前瞻性验证，但可为临床选择复律时机和患者分层提供参考。

summary_zh: 引言：电复律（ECV）能有效恢复持续性心房颤动（AF）和心房扑动（AFL）患者的窦性心律，尽管心律失常复发常见。我们旨在识别与成功ECV后一个月维持窦性心律概率较高相关的因素，以及在第一个月无心律失常者中一年后维持窦性心律的相关因素。方法：这项回顾性、单中心研究纳入2011年1月至2023年6月期间因持续性AF或AFL接受择期ECV的患者。分析临床、心电图和超声心动图特征，以识别与维持窦性心律相关的参数。结果：我们纳入297例ECV操作。ECV在91.9%的患者中成功，其中89.7%在随访一个月时维持窦性心律，40.3%在一年时维持窦性心律。较短的心律失常持续时间（OR = 0.863，95% CI：0.76–0.98，p = 0.026）和术前心电图上的心室起搏（OR = 5.212，95% CI：1.16–23.48，p = 0.032）与一个月成功相关。在每月随访期间维持窦性心律的患者中，与一年窦性心律维持相关的因素为较小的左心房尺寸（OR = 0.817，95%CI：0.77–0.98，p = 0.022）、首次心律失常发作（OR = 3.320，95%CI：1.10–10.05，p = 0.034）、较低的CHA 2 DS 2 -VASc评分（OR = 0.132，95%CI：0.03–0.54，p = 0.005）、非吸烟状态（OR = 0.120，95%CI：0.04–0.37，p < 0.001）、既往无ECV（OR = 0.082，95%CI：0.01–0.47，p = 0.005）和抗心律失常治疗（OR = 2.486，95%CI：1.01–8.65，p = 0.05）。结论：ECV是AF/AFL合理的节律控制策略，尤其是在心律失常发作后早期进行、非吸烟者和合并症较少的患者、接受抗心律失常治疗、左心房较小且既往无ECV的患者中。

title: Prognostic associations of left atrial strain with major adverse cardiovascular events and atrial fibrillation: Data from the Akershus Cardiac Examination (ACE) 1950 Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Left atrial (LA) reservoir (LASr), conduit (LAScd) and contractile (LASct) strain are known to reflect atrial remodeling and is prognostic in atrial fibrillation (AF) and heart failure. Evidence is scarce on prediction of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in general populations. LA mechanical dispersion (LA MD) and stiffness index (LASI) are less studied strain-derived indices of AF and cardiovascular risk.

METHODS: The Akershus Cardiac Examination 1950 Study included 3706 participants from the general population who underwent baseline echocardiography in 2012-2015. MACE (cardiovascular death, non-fatal stroke, non-fatal myocardial infarction or coronary intervention) and incident AF were recorded through 2022. Prognostic value of LA strain was assessed by Cox regression.

RESULTS: In 3229 participants with baseline LA strain analysis, MACE was recorded in 242 (7.5%) and incident AF in 157 (5.0%) over a median 8.3 years (IQR 7.9-8.9) of follow-up. LASr, LAScd and LASI were associated with MACE in univariable analyses, and LASI remained independently associated with MACE after multivariable adjustment (HR per 1SD increment 1.12, 95% CI 1.04-1.21). LASr (HR per 1SD decrement 1.21, 95% CI 1.01-1.45), LASct (HR per 1SD decrement 1.26, 95% CI 1.04-1.52) and LA MD (HR per 1SD increment 1.23, 95% CI 1.03-1.48) were independently associated with incident AF after multivariable adjustment. Accounting for competing risk of all-cause death, LA MD remained independently associated with incident AF, whereas LASr and LASct did not.

CONCLUSION: In a general population, LASI was independently associated with MACE, whereas LASr, LASct and LA MD were associated with incident AF.

AI.tldr: 在一般人群中，左房僵硬指数（LASI）与主要不良心血管事件（MACE）独立相关，而左房储器应变（LASr）、收缩应变（LASct）和机械离散度（LA MD）与房颤发生独立相关。
AI.motivation: 左房应变参数反映心房重构，在房颤和心衰中具有预后价值，但在一般人群中预测主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的证据 scarce，且 LA MD 和 LASI 等应变衍生指标研究较少。
AI.method: Akershus 心脏检查 1950 研究纳入 3706 名一般人群参与者，2012-2015 年接受基线超声心动图，随访至 2022 年记录 MACE（心血管死亡、非致死性卒中、非致死性心肌梗死或冠脉介入）和房颤发生。对 3229 名有基线左房应变分析者，采用 Cox 回归评估左房应变的预后价值。
AI.result: 中位随访 8.3 年（IQR 7.9-8.9），242 例（7.5%）发生 MACE，157 例（5.0%）发生房颤。多变量调整后，LASI 与 MACE 独立相关（每增加 1SD，HR 1.12，95% CI 1.04-1.21）；LASr（每降低 1SD，HR 1.21，95% CI 1.01-1.45）、LASct（每降低 1SD，HR 1.26，95% CI 1.04-1.52）和 LA MD（每增加 1SD，HR 1.23，95% CI 1.03-1.48）与房颤发生独立相关。考虑全因死亡竞争风险后，LA MD 仍与房颤独立相关，而 LASr 和 LASct 则不再显著。
AI.conclusion: 在一般人群中，LASI 是 MACE 的独立预测因子，LASr、LASct 和 LA MD 与房颤发生相关。这些应变指标可能有助于心血管风险分层，但需外部验证，且摘要未报告其他临床变量和模型区分度。

summary_zh:
背景：左心房（LA）储器应变（LASr）、管道应变（LAScd）和收缩应变（LASct）已知可反映心房重构，并在心房颤动（AF）和心力衰竭中具有预后价值。在一般人群中预测主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的证据尚缺乏。LA机械离散度（LA MD）和僵硬度指数（LASI）是研究较少的应变衍生指标，用于评估AF和心血管风险。

方法：Akershus心脏检查1950研究纳入了3706名来自一般人群的参与者，他们在2012-2015年接受了基线超声心动图检查。MACE（心血管死亡、非致死性卒中、非致死性心肌梗死或冠状动脉介入治疗）和新发AF记录至2022年。通过Cox回归评估LA应变的预后价值。

结果：在3229名具有基线LA应变分析的参与者中，中位随访8.3年（IQR 7.9-8.9）期间，记录到242例（7.5%）MACE和157例（5.0%）新发AF。在单变量分析中，LASr、LAScd和LASI与MACE相关，多变量调整后LASI仍与MACE独立相关（每1SD增量HR 1.12，95% CI 1.04-1.21）。多变量调整后，LASr（每1SD减量HR 1.21，95% CI 1.01-1.45）、LASct（每1SD减量HR 1.26，95% CI 1.04-1.52）和LA MD（每1SD增量HR 1.23，95% CI 1.03-1.48）与新发AF独立相关。考虑全因死亡的竞争风险后，LA MD仍与新发AF独立相关，而LASr和LASct则不然。

结论：在一般人群中，LASI与MACE独立相关，而LASr、LASct和LA MD与新发AF相关。

title: Characterization of Patients with Atrial Fibrillation Treated Inadequately with Anticoagulants: Why Hospitalization Is Not an Opportunity to Correct Errors.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a common cardiac arrhythmia. Prevalence increases with age. It is a major public health concern due to high risk of thromboembolic complications such as stroke and systemic embolism. Direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) have been shown to have improved safety and efficacy profiles and are the preferred therapy in all recent guidelines. However, patients are still discharged from internal medicine wards without appropriate DOAC therapy.

OBJECTIVES: To investigate the effectiveness of hospitalization in correcting inappropriate therapy for AF in patients who were hospitalized in the internal medicine departments for any reason and discharged without receiving DOAC therapy.

METHODS: In this retrospective cohort study, we gathered data from electronic medical records at Sheba Medical Center on 222 patients. The patients were divided into three groups based on the anticoagulation therapy they received.

RESULTS: The patient cohort (mean age of 77.1 years; 42.3% males; 21.6% presented with cognitive impairment. Researchers identified several potential contraindications for DOACs (renal disease in 24.3%, mechanical valves in 14.4%). When comparing patients with and without DOAC contraindications, there were no statistically significant differences regarding cognitive impairment rates or the lack of anticoagulation therapy. We further divided patients who did not receive DOACs into two groups: 134 due to contraindications and 88 mistakenly. Between these groups, baseline factors showed no statistically significant differences.

CONCLUSIONS: We found that older patients received less standardized care. Findings emphasize the need to consider individual patient characteristics and co-morbidities to eliminate management errors and improve the quality of clinical care.

AI.tldr: 回顾性队列显示，222例房颤住院患者出院时仍有88例被错误地未接受DOAC治疗，且高龄患者接受的治疗更不规范。
AI.motivation: 房颤是常见心律失常，患病率随年龄增长，血栓栓塞并发症（卒中、体循环栓塞）风险高。DOACs安全性和有效性优于传统抗凝，已被所有近期指南推荐为首选。然而，临床实践中仍有患者在内科病房出院时未接受适当的DOAC治疗，住院是否被用来纠正这一用药错误尚不清楚。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，数据来自Sheba医疗中心电子病历，共纳入222例因任何原因入住内科病房的房颤患者。按所接受的抗凝治疗分为三组；将未接受DOAC者进一步分为有禁忌证（134例）与错误未用（88例）两组。比较各组基线特征、认知障碍比例及无抗凝治疗情况，统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 患者平均年龄77.1岁，男性42.3%，认知障碍21.6%。潜在DOAC禁忌证包括肾脏疾病24.3%、机械瓣14.4%。有与无DOAC禁忌证的患者在认知障碍比例及未抗凝治疗方面无统计学显著差异；禁忌证组与错误未用组之间基线因素亦无统计学显著差异。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 住院未能成为纠正房颤抗凝治疗错误的契机，高龄患者接受的治疗更不标准化。临床应结合患者个体特征与合并症识别并消除管理错误，提高抗凝治疗质量；但本研究为单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限，且未报告关键统计数值，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）是一种常见的心律失常。患病率随年龄增长而增加。由于卒中和系统性栓塞等血栓栓塞并发症的高风险，它是一个主要的公共卫生问题。直接口服抗凝药（DOACs）已被证明具有改善的安全性和有效性特征，并且在所有近期指南中都是首选治疗。然而，患者仍在内科病房出院时未接受适当的DOAC治疗。

目的：探讨住院对于纠正因任何原因在内科病房住院并出院时未接受DOAC治疗的AF患者的不适当治疗的有效性。

方法：在这项回顾性队列研究中，我们收集了Sheba医疗中心222名患者的电子病历数据。根据患者接受抗凝治疗的情况，将患者分为三组。

结果：患者队列（平均年龄77.1岁；42.3%为男性；21.6%存在认知障碍。研究人员确定了DOAC的若干潜在禁忌症（肾脏疾病占24.3%，机械瓣膜占14.4%）。在比较有和无DOAC禁忌症的患者时，认知障碍发生率或缺乏抗凝治疗方面无统计学显著差异。我们进一步将未接受DOAC的患者分为两组：134例因禁忌症，88例因误判。在这些组之间，基线因素显示无统计学显著差异。

结论：我们发现老年患者接受的标准化治疗较少。研究结果强调需要考虑个体患者特征和合并症，以消除管理错误并提高临床护理质量。

title: Elevated lithium levels in drinking water are associated with higher prevalence of Wolff-Parkinson-White diagnoses.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) and Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) are potentially highly symptomatic and, rarely, lethal arrhythmias associated with atrioventricular accessory pathways. While the etiology of accessory pathways remains largely unknown, they are frequently observed with Ebstein's Anomaly, a congenital heart disease associated with maternal medicinal lithium use. Therefore, we evaluated whether in utero exposure to lithium from environmental sources is associated with the prevalence of accessory pathways.

METHODS: We conducted a county-level ecological comparison of lithium levels in drinking water versus prevalence of WPW diagnoses among patients < 18-years-old in California using multivariable logistic regression. Children were analyzed given their high likelihood to reside in the same county during fetal development. WPW cases were identified using diagnostic codes. Positive and negative controls, including falsification endpoints, were analyzed.

RESULTS: Among 2,329,090 patients (mean age 8.2 ± 5.9 years, 47.8% female), 686 (0.03%) were diagnosed with WPW. Areas where lithium levels ≥ 75th percentile were associated with 71% greater odds of WPW (OR 1.71, 95% CI 1.44 to 2.03). Areas above the lithium health-based screening limit had 29% greater odds of WPW (OR 1.29, 95% CI 1.05 to 1.58). Similar results existed in a New York statewide cohort. In validation analyses, areas where lithium levels ≥ 75th percentile were associated with a higher prevalence of SVT, syncope, palpitations, and catheter ablation procedures.

CONCLUSIONS: Higher lithium levels in drinking water were associated with a greater prevalence of childhood-diagnosed WPW, implicating a potentially modifiable risk factor for the development of accessory pathways.

AI.tldr: 饮用水锂水平≥75百分位与儿童WPW诊断风险增加71%相关（OR 1.71），提示环境锂暴露可能是旁路形成的可干预危险因素。
AI.motivation: 室上性心动过速和WPW与房室旁路相关，但旁路病因 largely 未知。既往发现母体药用锂与Ebstein畸形（常伴旁路）相关，因此探讨环境来源的宫内锂暴露是否与旁路患病率相关。
AI.method: 在加州开展县水平生态学比较，纳入<18岁患者2,329,090例（平均年龄8.2±5.9岁，女性47.8%），采用多变量logistic回归分析饮用水锂水平与WPW诊断（基于诊断编码）的关联，并设置阳性、阴性对照及伪造终点，在纽约州队列中重复验证。
AI.result: 共686例（0.03%）诊断为WPW。锂水平≥75百分位的地区WPW风险增加71%（OR 1.71，95%CI 1.44-2.03）；超过健康筛查限值的地区风险增加29%（OR 1.29，95%CI 1.05-1.58）。纽约州队列结果类似。验证分析中，高锂地区SVT、晕厥、心悸及导管消融的患病率也更高。
AI.conclusion: 饮用水锂水平较高与儿童期诊断的WPW患病率增加相关，提示环境锂暴露可能是旁路形成的可干预危险因素。但研究为生态学设计，不能推断个体暴露与因果关系，需进一步个体水平研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：室上性心动过速（SVT）和Wolff-Parkinson-White（WPW）综合征是可能症状明显且罕见致命的心律失常，与房室旁路相关。虽然旁路的病因在很大程度上仍不清楚，但它们常与Ebstein畸形（一种与母亲药用锂使用相关的先天性心脏病）一起出现。因此，我们评估了环境来源的宫内锂暴露是否与旁路的患病率相关。

方法：我们使用多变量逻辑回归，对加利福尼亚州18岁以下患者中饮用水锂水平与WPW诊断患病率进行了县级生态学比较。选择儿童进行分析是因为他们在胎儿发育期间居住在同一县的可能性很高。WPW病例通过诊断代码识别。分析了阳性和阴性对照，包括伪造终点。

结果：在2,329,090名患者中（平均年龄8.2 ± 5.9岁，47.8%为女性），686名（0.03%）被诊断为WPW。锂水平≥第75百分位的地区与WPW的 odds 增加71%相关（OR 1.71，95% CI 1.44至2.03）。高于锂健康筛查限值的地区WPW的 odds 增加29%（OR 1.29，95% CI 1.05至1.58）。在纽约州队列中也存在类似结果。在验证分析中，锂水平≥第75百分位的地区与SVT、晕厥、心悸和导管消融手术的更高患病率相关。

结论：饮用水中较高的锂水平与儿童诊断的WPW患病率较高相关，提示旁路发育的一个潜在可修改风险因素。

title: Ionizing radiation-induced remodelling of the heart: Cellular pathways and crosstalk relevant to stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation (STAR).
summary: Stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation (STAR) has emerged as a promising non-invasive therapy for refractory ventricular tachycardia, yet its biological mechanisms remain poorly defined. While conventional catheter ablation achieves arrhythmia control through structural remodelling, radiotherapy was initially assumed to act similarly. However, STAR reduces ventricular arrhythmia burden within weeks, preceding the development of radiation-induced structural remodelling. This temporal mismatch indicates that early anti-arrhythmic effects are probably driven by functional adaptations. Human tissue findings and preclinical large- and small-animal models have provided the first insights into how the myocardium responds to focal high-dose radiation, yet experimental data on STAR's underlying cellular mechanisms remain limited. Across these studies, a consistent observation is the temporal dissociation between early functional effects and delayed structural remodelling, which provides a key framework for interpretating STAR's anti-arrhythmic action. In this review, we synthesize current evidence on cell-type-specific responses to ionizing radiation by integrating insights from the emerging STAR literature, oncology and radiation heart disease models. By linking time-resolved cellular responses to clinical observations, we aim to distinguish mechanisms most relevant to early therapeutic effects from those contributing to delayed remodelling, and to define key knowledge gaps for guiding safe and effective clinical implementation.

AI.tldr: STAR 的早期抗心律失常作用可能源于功能性适应而非结构性重构，但具体细胞机制尚不明确，需进一步研究。
AI.motivation: STAR 是治疗难治性室速的有前景的无创疗法，但其生物学机制不清；临床观察到 STAR 在数周内减少室性心律失常负荷，早于放射性结构重构的出现，这种时间不匹配提示早期效应可能由功能适应驱动，而既往证据有限。
AI.method: 综述性研究，整合新兴 STAR 文献、肿瘤学及放射性心脏病模型的证据，分析心肌对局灶高剂量辐射的细胞类型特异性反应，并关联时间分辨的细胞反应与临床观察。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体统计数据；一致观察是早期功能效应与延迟结构重构之间的时间分离，为解释 STAR 的抗心律失常作用提供关键框架。
AI.conclusion: STAR 的早期抗心律失常效应可能由功能性适应介导，区别于传统消融的结构重构机制；需进一步研究明确关键知识缺口，以指导安全有效的临床实施，但现有实验数据有限。

summary_zh: 立体定向心律失常放射消融（STAR）已成为治疗难治性室性心动过速的一种有前景的非侵入性疗法，但其生物学机制仍不明确。传统导管消融通过结构性重构实现心律失常控制，而放疗最初被认为作用类似。然而，STAR可在数周内减少室性心律失常负荷，早于放射性结构重构的发生。这种时间上的不匹配表明，早期抗心律失常效应可能由功能性适应驱动。人类组织学发现及临床前大、小动物模型首次揭示了心肌对局灶高剂量放射的反应，但关于STAR潜在细胞机制的实验数据仍然有限。在这些研究中，一个一致的观察是早期功能效应与延迟结构重构之间的时间分离，这为解释STAR的抗心律失常作用提供了关键框架。在本综述中，我们通过整合新兴STAR文献、肿瘤学及放射性心脏病模型的见解，总结了关于电离辐射细胞类型特异性反应的当前证据。通过将时间分辨的细胞反应与临床观察相联系，我们旨在区分与早期治疗效应最相关的机制和导致延迟重构的机制，并明确指导安全有效临床实施的关键知识空白。

title: Association of the triglyceride-glucose index and triglyceride-glucose-body mass index with postoperative atrial fibrillation in patients undergoing off-pump coronary artery bypass grafting: a retrospective cohort study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is a common complication following off-pump coronary artery bypass grafting (OPCABG). Insulin resistance (IR) contributes to the pathogenesis of POAF. IR-related markers, including the triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index and the triglyceride-glucose-body mass index (TyG-BMI), have demonstrated prognostic value for cardiovascular events. However, their associations with POAF specifically after OPCABG remain unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the associations of TyG and TyG-BMI with POAF and their incremental value beyond conventional clinical risk factors.

METHODS: We conducted a single-center retrospective cohort study of adult patients who underwent isolated OPCABG between December 2020 and December 2021. Of 757 otherwise eligible patients, 93 without the preoperative fasting glucose and/or triglyceride measurements required to calculate the indices were excluded, leaving 664 participants in the primary analysis. Multivariable logistic regression, restricted cubic spline (RCS), discrimination and reclassification analyses, and bootstrap internal validation were performed.

RESULTS: Of the 664 participants, 180 (27.1%) developed POAF. In the fully adjusted model, each standard deviation increase in TyG and TyG-BMI was associated with higher odds of POAF [TyG: odds ratio (OR), 1.55; 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.28-1.89; TyG-BMI: OR, 1.60; 95% CI: 1.31-1.96; both P<0.001]. RCS analysis showed an approximately linear association for TyG (P for nonlinearity =0.16) and a nonlinear association for TyG-BMI (P for nonlinearity =0.02). Adding TyG or TyG-BMI to the baseline model increased the C-statistic from 0.682 to 0.708 or 0.707, respectively, although the changes were not statistically significant (P=0.07 and P=0.08). Both indices improved the integrated discrimination improvement (IDI) and continuous net reclassification improvement (NRI) (all P<0.001). Associations were stronger among patients with diabetes (P for interaction =0.02 for TyG and 0.005 for TyG-BMI).

CONCLUSIONS: Higher preoperative TyG and TyG-BMI values were independently associated with POAF after OPCABG. These routinely available indices provided modest incremental risk information beyond conventional clinical risk factors. External validation is required before their use for clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 在非体外循环冠脉搭桥（OPCABG）患者中，术前TyG指数和TyG-BMI升高与术后房颤（POAF）独立相关，每升高1个标准差OR约1.55-1.60，但增量预测价值有限。
AI.motivation: POAF是OPCABG术后常见并发症，胰岛素抵抗参与其发生。TyG指数和TyG-BMI作为胰岛素抵抗相关指标，对心血管事件有预后价值，但其与OPCABG术后POAF的关系尚不明确，且能否在传统临床危险因素之外提供增量风险信息亦不清楚。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2020年12月至2021年12月接受单纯OPCABG的成人患者；757例初筛者中93例因缺少计算指标所需的术前空腹血糖和/或甘油三酯被排除，最终664例进入主要分析。采用多变量logistic回归、限制性立方样条（RCS）、判别与重分类分析及bootstrap内部验证，评估TyG和TyG-BMI与POAF的关联及其增量价值。
AI.result: 664例中180例（27.1%）发生POAF。完全校正模型中，TyG每升高1个标准差，POAF风险增加（OR 1.55，95%CI 1.28-1.89）；TyG-BMI每升高1个标准差，POAF风险增加（OR 1.60，95%CI 1.31-1.96），均P<0.001。RCS显示TyG呈近似线性关联（非线性P=0.16），TyG-BMI呈非线性关联（非线性P=0.02）。将TyG或TyG-BMI加入基线模型后，C统计量由0.682分别升至0.708或0.707，但差异无统计学意义（P=0.07和P=0.08）；两者均改善IDI和连续NRI（均P<0.001）。在糖尿病患者中关联更强（TyG交互P=0.02，TyG-BMI交互P=0.005）。
AI.conclusion: 术前TyG和TyG-BMI升高与OPCABG术后POAF独立相关，这些常规可获得的指标可在传统临床危险因素之外提供有限的增量风险信息；在用于临床决策前尚需外部验证。本研究为单中心回顾性设计，存在残余混杂可能，且增量判别能力未达统计学显著。

summary_zh:
背景：术后心房颤动（POAF）是非体外循环冠状动脉旁路移植术（OPCABG）后常见的并发症。胰岛素抵抗（IR）参与POAF的发病机制。IR相关标志物，包括甘油三酯-葡萄糖（TyG）指数和甘油三酯-葡萄糖-体重指数（TyG-BMI），已显示出对心血管事件的预后价值。然而，它们与OPCABG后POAF的特异性关联仍不清楚。本研究旨在评估TyG和TyG-BMI与POAF的关联及其在传统临床危险因素之外的增量价值。

方法：我们进行了一项单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2020年12月至2021年12月期间接受孤立OPCABG的成年患者。在757例其他方面符合条件的患者中，93例因缺乏计算指数所需的术前空腹血糖和/或甘油三酯测量值而被排除，最终664例参与者纳入主要分析。进行了多变量逻辑回归、限制性立方样条（RCS）、判别和重分类分析以及bootstrap内部验证。

结果：在664例参与者中，180例（27.1%）发生POAF。在完全调整模型中，TyG和TyG-BMI每增加一个标准差与POAF的更高几率相关[TyG：比值比（OR），1.55；95%置信区间（CI）：1.28-1.89；TyG-BMI：OR，1.60；95% CI：1.31-1.96；均P<0.001]。RCS分析显示TyG呈近似线性关联（非线性P=0.16），TyG-BMI呈非线性关联（非线性P=0.02）。将TyG或TyG-BMI加入基线模型后，C统计量分别从0.682增加到0.708或0.707，尽管变化无统计学显著性（P=0.07和P=0.08）。两种指数均改善了综合判别改善指数（IDI）和连续净重分类改善指数（NRI）（均P<0.001）。在糖尿病患者中关联更强（TyG的交互作用P=0.02，TyG-BMI的交互作用P=0.005）。

结论：较高的术前TyG和TyG-BMI值与OPCABG后POAF独立相关。这些常规可用的指数在传统临床危险因素之外提供了适度的增量风险信息。在用于临床决策之前需要进行外部验证。

title: Echocardiography-based multimodal models for thromboembolic risk prediction in atrial fibrillation: a narrative review.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: The congestive heart failure, hypertension, age ≥75 years, diabetes, stroke, vascular disease, age 65-74 years, sex category (CHA2DS2-VASc) score is fundamental for assessing thromboembolic risk in atrial fibrillation (AF). However, its limitations arise from relying solely on clinical parameters, without considering individual cardiac structural and functional changes. This review aims to explore the development and implementation of multimodal risk prediction models that integrate echocardiographic parameters with clinical data and biomarkers to achieve a more precise and individualized risk assessment.

METHODS: A comprehensive literature search was conducted using relevant electronic databases (e.g., PubMed, Web of Science and Embase) to identify studies focusing on echocardiographic parameters, AF, and thromboembolic risk prediction models published up to May 2026.

KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: Echocardiographic parameters evaluating the left atrium and left atrial appendage (LAA; size, function, and morphology) have emerged as significant predictors of both prevalent thrombus formation and future thromboembolic events. This review details these key parameters and critically assesses various multimodal approaches, including those combining clinical-echocardiographic scores with artificial intelligence (AI) techniques. Importantly, these models demonstrate enhanced predictive accuracy for specific clinical endpoints over traditional clinical scores.

CONCLUSIONS: Utilizing a multimodal approach provides a promising supplementary tool for refined risk assessment, rather than replacing guideline-based anticoagulation decisions. Future directions should focus on standardizing echocardiographic measurements, expanding the use of AI for automated analysis, and conducting prospective interventional trials to confirm clinical benefit.

AI.tldr: 整合超声心动图参数的多模态模型可提高房颤血栓栓塞风险预测准确性，但尚不能替代指南抗凝决策。
AI.motivation: CHA2DS2-VASc评分仅基于临床参数，未考虑心脏结构和功能变化，预测血栓栓塞风险存在局限，需要更精准的个体化评估工具。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，检索PubMed、Web of Science和Embase截至2026年5月关于超声心动图参数、房颤与血栓栓塞风险预测模型的研究，评估多模态模型（临床-超声评分联合人工智能）的预测效能。
AI.result: 左心房及左心耳大小、功能和形态等超声参数是血栓形成和血栓栓塞事件的重要预测因素；多模态模型对特定临床终点的预测准确性优于传统临床评分，但摘要未报告具体效应量及95%CI。
AI.conclusion: 多模态方法可作为精细化风险评估的补充工具，而非替代指南抗凝决策；未来需标准化超声测量、推广AI自动化分析并开展前瞻性干预试验验证临床获益。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：充血性心力衰竭、高血压、年龄≥75岁、糖尿病、卒中、血管疾病、年龄65-74岁、性别类别（CHA2DS2-VASc）评分是评估心房颤动（AF）血栓栓塞风险的基础。然而，其局限性在于仅依赖临床参数，未考虑个体心脏结构和功能变化。本综述旨在探讨整合超声心动图参数与临床数据和生物标志物的多模态风险预测模型的开发与实施，以实现更精确和个体化的风险评估。

方法：使用相关电子数据库（如PubMed、Web of Science和Embase）进行了全面的文献检索，以识别截至2026年5月发表的关注超声心动图参数、AF和血栓栓塞风险预测模型的研究。

关键内容与发现：评估左心房和左心耳（LAA；大小、功能和形态）的超声心动图参数已成为既存血栓形成和未来血栓栓塞事件的重要预测因素。本综述详细介绍了这些关键参数，并批判性地评估了各种多模态方法，包括将临床-超声心动图评分与人工智能（AI）技术相结合的方法。重要的是，这些模型在特定临床终点上显示出比传统临床评分更高的预测准确性。

结论：利用多模态方法为精细化风险评估提供了有前景的补充工具，而非替代基于指南的抗凝决策。未来方向应侧重于标准化超声心动图测量、扩大AI在自动化分析中的应用，并开展前瞻性干预试验以确认临床获益。

title: Orai3 deficiency drives atrial remodeling and fibrillation susceptibility via Orai channel remodeling and SOCE hyperactivation.
summary:
AIMS: Atrial remodeling is the pathological substrate for atrial fibrillation (AF), yet no targeted therapies exist. The Orai3 calcium channel regulates cardiac homeostasis, but its role in atrial remodeling remains unexplored.

METHODS: Wild type and Orai3 knockout rats were subjected to Angiotensin II infusion or acetylcholine‑calcium chloride injection to model atrial fibrosis and AF. Cardiac function, Orai channel related protein expression and co-localization, SOCE activity, and downstream signaling were evaluated by echocardiography, histology, immunofluorescence, calcium imaging, and western blotting.

RESULTS: Orai3 deficiency exacerbated Ang II induced atrial dilation, fibrosis, and ultrastructural damage, with transcriptomic analysis revealing enrichment of extracellular matrix pathways. Mechanistically, Orai3 loss was associated with reduced Orai1/Orai3 co-localization and enhanced Orai1/STIM1 co-localization, driving SOCE hyperactivation. This aberrant Ca2+ signal bidirectionally upregulated TGF-β and suppressed Cx43 effects reversible by SOCE inhibition or Orai3 overexpression. Orai3 has been proposed to function as a molecular rheostat that down tunes STIM1 mediated gating when in complex with Orai1, its loss removes this brake, unleashing pathological SOCE. Consequently, Orai3 deficient rats exhibited increased AF susceptibility, with disrupted Cx43 distribution, shortened gap junctions, and impaired STAT3 mediated Cx43 transcription.

CONCLUSIONS: Orai3 acts as an endogenous protective brake against atrial cardiomyopathy. The Orai3-SOCE-TGF-β/Cx43 axis links calcium dyshomeostasis to both fibrotic and electrical remodeling, positioning Orai3 as a potential prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target for AF.

AI.tldr: Orai3缺失通过Orai通道重塑和SOCE过度激活加剧心房纤维化与电重构，增加房颤易感性，提示Orai3是潜在治疗靶点。
AI.motivation: 心房重构是房颤的病理基础，但目前缺乏靶向治疗。Orai3钙通道调控心脏稳态，但其在心房重构中的作用尚未明确。
AI.method: 研究类型为动物实验。对象为野生型和Orai3敲除大鼠，通过血管紧张素II输注或乙酰胆碱-氯化钙注射构建心房纤维化和房颤模型。评估心脏功能、Orai通道相关蛋白表达与共定位、SOCE活性及下游信号，采用超声心动图、组织学、免疫荧光、钙成像和蛋白质印迹。
AI.result: Orai3缺失加重Ang II诱导的心房扩张、纤维化和超微结构损伤，转录组分析显示细胞外基质通路富集。机制上，Orai3缺失减少Orai1/Orai3共定位、增强Orai1/STIM1共定位，驱动SOCE过度激活；异常钙信号双向上调TGF-β并抑制Cx43，SOCE抑制或Orai3过表达可逆转。Orai3缺失大鼠房颤易感性增加，Cx43分布紊乱、缝隙连接缩短、STAT3介导的Cx43转录受损。摘要未报告具体效应量和P值。
AI.conclusion: Orai3是心房心肌病的内源性保护性刹车，Orai3-SOCE-TGF-β/Cx43轴连接钙稳态失衡与纤维化及电重构，提示Orai3可作为房颤预后生物标志物和治疗靶点。但研究限于动物模型，临床转化需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
目的：心房重构是心房颤动（AF）的病理基础，但目前尚无靶向治疗。Orai3 钙通道调控心脏稳态，但其在心房重构中的作用尚未被探索。

方法：将野生型和 Orai3 敲除大鼠接受血管紧张素 II 输注或乙酰胆碱-氯化钙注射，以构建心房纤维化和 AF 模型。通过超声心动图、组织学、免疫荧光、钙成像和蛋白质印迹评估心脏功能、Orai 通道相关蛋白表达及共定位、SOCE 活性以及下游信号传导。

结果：Orai3 缺陷加重了 Ang II 诱导的心房扩张、纤维化和超微结构损伤，转录组分析显示细胞外基质通路富集。机制上，Orai3 缺失与 Orai1/Orai3 共定位减少和 Orai1/STIM1 共定位增强相关，驱动 SOCE 过度激活。这种异常的 Ca2+ 信号双向上调 TGF-β 并抑制 Cx43 效应，而 SOCE 抑制或 Orai3 过表达可逆转这些效应。Orai3 被认为是一种分子变阻器，当与 Orai1 形成复合物时下调 STIM1 介导的门控，其缺失消除了这一刹车，释放病理性 SOCE。因此，Orai3 缺陷大鼠表现出 AF 易感性增加，伴有 Cx43 分布紊乱、缝隙连接缩短和 STAT3 介导的 Cx43 转录受损。

结论：Orai3 作为对抗心房心肌病的内源性保护刹车。Orai3-SOCE-TGF-β/Cx43 轴将钙稳态失衡与纤维化和电重构联系起来，使 Orai3 成为 AF 的潜在预后生物标志物和治疗靶点。

title: Impact of atrial fibrillation catheter ablation o'n tricuspid regurgitation severity: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) and tricuspid regurgitation (TR) commonly coexist and are associated with adverse clinical outcomes. Whether restoration of sinus rhythm through catheter ablation improves TR severity has not been systematically quantified. We evaluated the association between AF catheter ablation and changes in moderate or greater TR.

METHODS: We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies evaluating patients with AF undergoing catheter ablation and reporting paired preablation and postablation assessments of TR severity. MEDLINE, Embase, CENTRAL and Web of Science were searched from inception to 22 April 2026. The primary outcome was change in the prevalence of moderate or greater TR following ablation. Random-effects meta-analysis was performed using restricted maximum likelihood estimation. Meta-regression evaluated prespecified study-level modifiers, including sex proportion, mean age and baseline AF type.

RESULTS: 17 studies comprising 2747 patients were included. AF catheter ablation was associated with a lower prevalence of moderate or greater TR (risk difference −0.21, 95% CI −0.33 to −0.09; pooled risk ratio 0.49, 95% CI 0.40 to 0.60), although heterogeneity was substantial (I²=98.3%) and the 95% prediction interval was wide (−0.74 to 0.31). Patients who maintained sinus rhythm had greater TR reduction than those with recurrent AF (risk difference −0.28, 95% CI −0.55 to −0.01). In meta-regression, higher proportions of female participants and persistent AF were associated with greater TR improvement, whereas mean left ventricular ejection fraction was not. Findings were consistent in sensitivity analyses restricted to studies at low-to-moderate risk of bias, observational studies and leave-one-out analyses.

CONCLUSIONS: AF catheter ablation was associated with a significant reduction in moderate or greater TR, with greater improvement among patients maintaining sinus rhythm. These findings support prospective evaluation of rhythm control as a potential strategy for patients with moderate or greater TR and AF.

title: Association Between Baseline Cognitive Impairment and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Catheter Ablation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Cognitive impairment is common among patients with atrial fibrillation (AF), yet its prognostic significance in the context of catheter ablation remains unclear.

AIMS: We aimed to investigate whether baseline cognitive impairment, assessed by the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), was associated with post-ablation AF recurrence.

METHODS: Based on the China-AF Registry, we identified 2692 patients with nonvalvular AF who underwent index catheter ablation and had baseline MoCA assessments from 2022 to 2024. Patients were stratified into mild cognitive impairment (MCI, MoCA ≤ 26) and normal cognition (MoCA > 26) groups. The primary outcome was AF recurrence beyond the blanking period. The secondary outcome was a composite of all-cause death, ischemic stroke, and major bleeding. To adjust for confounding factors, we applied inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) methodology. Weighted Cox proportional hazards models were used to estimate adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs).

RESULTS: After IPTW adjustment, all baseline covariates were well balanced (all standardized mean differences < 0.03). Over a median follow-up of 218 days (IQR, 192-376), the MCI group had a significantly higher risk of AF recurrence (aHR 1.48; 95% CI, 1.27-1.73; p < 0.001). The composite secondary endpoint did not demonstrate a statistically significant between-group difference (aHR, 1.05; 95% CI, 0.25-4.52; p = 0.945). The association between baseline MCI and AF recurrence was consistent across all prespecified subgroups (all p for interaction > 0.05).

CONCLUSION: In this large prospective registry study, an independent association was observed between baseline cognitive impairment and an elevated risk of post-ablation AF recurrence. Cognitive assessment may be useful for risk stratification but requires external validation.

AI.tldr: 在2692例接受导管消融的非瓣膜性房颤患者中，基线轻度认知障碍（MoCA≤26）与消融后房颤复发风险独立相关（aHR 1.48），但复合硬终点无差异。
AI.motivation: 认知障碍在房颤患者中常见，但其对导管消融术后房颤复发的预后意义尚不明确，既往缺乏大样本前瞻性研究证据。
AI.method: 基于中国房颤注册研究（China-AF Registry）的前瞻性队列，纳入2022至2024年接受首次导管消融且完成基线MoCA评估的非瓣膜性房颤患者2692例，按MoCA≤26分为轻度认知障碍（MCI）组、>26分为正常认知组。主要终点为空白期后的房颤复发，次要终点为全因死亡、缺血性卒中和大出血的复合终点。采用逆概率治疗加权（IPTW）平衡混杂因素，加权Cox比例风险模型估计校正风险比（aHR）。
AI.result: 中位随访218天（IQR 192-376）。IPTW后所有基线协变量均衡（标准化均数差均<0.03）。MCI组房颤复发风险显著升高（aHR 1.48；95% CI 1.27-1.73；P<0.001）。复合次要终点组间无统计学差异（aHR 1.05；95% CI 0.25-4.52；P=0.945）。基线MCI与房颤复发的关联在所有预设亚组中一致（交互作用P均>0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 本大型前瞻性注册研究显示，基线认知障碍与导管消融后房颤复发风险升高独立相关。认知评估或有助于房颤消融术前风险分层，但结论需外部验证；且随访时间较短、次要终点事件数少，认知障碍影响复发的机制及对硬终点的长期影响尚不明确。

目的：我们旨在研究通过蒙特利尔认知评估（MoCA）评估的基线认知障碍是否与消融后AF复发相关。

title: Timing of Catheter Ablation After Heart Failure Diagnosis for Atrial Fibrillation: A Propensity-Score-Matched Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catheter ablation improves outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and heart failure (HF). However, most of the evidence on the importance of ablation timing has been anchored to AF rather than HF onset, leaving the optimal interval between HF diagnosis and ablation incompletely defined.

OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the association between the timing of catheter ablation following the first diagnosis of HF and subsequent clinical outcomes in patients with established AF.

METHODS: We performed a retrospective propensity-score-matched cohort study using the TriNetX Research Network. Adults (≥18 years) with AF who subsequently developed HF and underwent catheter ablation were included. The primary analysis compared ablation from day 1 through 3 months after HF diagnosis with ablation at least 91 days after HF diagnosis. Propensity-score matching yielded 2,570 patients in each group. Outcomes were assessed for 2 years after ablation and included all-cause mortality, electrical cardioversion, emergency department or inpatient encounters, and HF exacerbation. A 1-year timing threshold and analyses stratified by recorded left ventricular ejection fraction were examined as sensitivity analyses.

RESULTS: Mean follow-up was 549.3±253.2 days after early ablation and 534.1±255.3 days after later ablation. Mortality was similar between groups (11.0% vs 10.0%; hazard ratio [HR] 1.078, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.910-1.276; p = 0.384), as were emergency department or inpatient encounters (66.2% vs 65.6%; HR 1.006, 95% CI 0.940-1.076; p = 0.865). Early ablation was associated with fewer cardioversions (15.0% vs 18.6%; HR 0.788, 95% CI 0.689-0.901; p < 0.001) and fewer HF exacerbation events (39.5% vs 46.0%; HR 0.824, 95% CI 0.758-0.896; p < 0.001). The 1-year timing analysis showed a similar pattern for cardioversion and the HF exacerbation.

CONCLUSIONS: Among patients with AF and HF who ultimately underwent ablation, ablation within 3 months of HF diagnosis was associated with fewer subsequent cardioversions and HF exacerbations than ablation performed from day 91 onward. However, there was no significant difference in mortality between the two cohorts. These findings identify the first months after HF diagnosis as a clinically relevant period for reassessing rhythm-control strategy and warrant prospective evaluation of ablation timing after HF recognition.

AI.tldr: 在AF合并HF患者中，HF诊断后3个月内行导管消融较91天后消融可减少电复律和HF加重事件，但全因死亡率无差异。
AI.motivation: 导管消融可改善AF合并HF患者预后，但既往证据多基于AF病程而非HF确诊时间，HF诊断至消融的最佳间隔尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性倾向性评分匹配队列研究，使用TriNetX数据库，纳入≥18岁先有AF后发生HF并接受导管消融的患者，比较HF诊断后1-3个月（早期）与≥91天（晚期）消融，匹配后每组2570例，评估消融后2年全因死亡、电复律、急诊/住院和HF加重，并进行1年阈值和按LVEF分层的敏感性分析。
AI.conclusion: HF诊断后3个月内行导管消融与电复律和HF加重减少相关，但未降低死亡率。HF确诊后最初数月是重新评估节律控制策略的关键窗口，需前瞻性研究验证消融时机。

summary_zh:
背景：导管消融可改善心房颤动（AF）合并心力衰竭（HF）患者的预后。然而，关于消融时机重要性的证据大多基于AF而非HF发病，导致HF诊断至消融的最佳间隔尚未完全明确。

目的：评估首次诊断HF后导管消融时机与既定AF患者后续临床结局之间的关联。

方法：我们使用TriNetX研究网络进行了一项回顾性倾向评分匹配队列研究。纳入年龄≥18岁、患有AF、随后发生HF并接受导管消融的成人。主要分析比较HF诊断后第1天至3个月内进行的消融与HF诊断后至少91天进行的消融。倾向评分匹配后每组各有2,570例患者。评估消融后2年内的结局，包括全因死亡率、电复律、急诊科或住院就诊以及HF加重。敏感性分析检验了1年时机阈值以及按记录的左心室射血分数分层的分析。

结果：早期消融后平均随访时间为549.3±253.2天，较晚消融后为534.1±255.3天。两组死亡率相似（11.0% vs 10.0%；风险比[HR] 1.078，95%置信区间[CI] 0.910-1.276；p = 0.384），急诊科或住院就诊也相似（66.2% vs 65.6%；HR 1.006，95% CI 0.940-1.076；p = 0.865）。早期消融与较少的电复律（15.0% vs 18.6%；HR 0.788，95% CI 0.689-0.901；p < 0.001）和较少的HF加重事件（39.5% vs 46.0%；HR 0.824，95% CI 0.758-0.896；p < 0.001）相关。1年时机分析显示电复律和HF加重呈现相似模式。

结论：在最终接受消融的AF合并HF患者中，HF诊断后3个月内进行消融与第91天及以后进行的消融相比，后续电复律和HF加重更少。然而，两个队列之间的死亡率无显著差异。这些发现表明HF诊断后的最初几个月是重新评估节律控制策略的临床相关时期，并值得对HF确诊后消融时机进行前瞻性评估。

title: Calibration and selective prediction dominate the cross-dataset gap in atrial fibrillation detection — reproducibility package
summary: Reproducibility package for a four-database leave-one-database-out study of cross-dataset atrial fibrillation detection. Contains the Kaggle kernel sources for every experiment stage (data preparation, LODO training, source-domain calibration, domain generalization, test-time adaptation, lead-subset and noise ablations, external validation, evidence-hardening analyses), the eight frozen ResNet1D checkpoints (four ERM, four DANN), the frozen per-seed metrics and per-target logits, the analysis/statistics/figure scripts, the verified BibTeX bibliography, and the LaTeX sources of the manuscript. All databases used are public (PTB-XL, CPSC2018, Chapman-Shaoxing, Georgia, MIT-BIH, NSTDB); raw ECG data are not redistributed. Training and inference ran on Kaggle GPU sessions (Tesla T4); a full re-run of the training stages takes about 6–8 GPU-hours, while the analysis-only stages need about one hour each because they reuse the frozen checkpoints. See README.md for run instructions.

title: Temporal Trends and Demographic Disparities in Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion Utilization in the United States, 2016–2022
summary: Abstract Background Left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) provides non-pharmacological stroke prevention for non-valvular atrial fibrillation patients with contraindications to long-term oral anticoagulation. National long-term data on age-adjusted utilization trends and demographic adoption disparities remain limited. Objectives To evaluate national temporal trends, hospital characteristics, clinical acuity shifts, and demographic adoption patterns of percutaneous LAAO procedures. Methods Using the National Inpatient Sample (NIS) from 2016 through 2022, percutaneous LAAO procedures were identified using ICD-10-PCS code 02L73DK. Weighted national estimates were used to evaluate patient demographics, hospital factors, clinical acuity, and overall in-hospital mortality. Age-adjusted rates per 100,000 population were calculated using direct standardization to the 2000 U.S. standard population. Results A total of 190,020 weighted LAAO procedures were identified increasing from 4,875 in 2016 to 60,445 in 2022. The mean patient age was 76.3 ± 7.6 years, and 58.5% were male. Most patients were White (90.4%), while Hispanic (4.3%), Black (3.9%), and Asian/Pacific Islander (1.3%) patients accounted for smaller proportions of procedures. Most procedures were performed at urban teaching hospitals (87.0%). Overall in-hospital mortality was 0.1% (n = 225, p = 0.582). Minor APR-DRG risk of mortality increased from 43.5% to 55.5%, while all others decreased ( p < 0.001). Age-adjusted LAAO rates rose from 34.19 to 379.87 per 100,000 population ( p -trend < 0.01). Significant differences in utilization across racial groups persisted throughout the study period. Conclusions Percutaneous LAAO utilization expanded rapidly with exceptionally low inpatient mortality. Persistent gaps in age-adjusted rates highlight key racial, sex, and geographic disparities in structural heart care. Condensed Abstract Using the 2016–2022 National Inpatient Sample, this study evaluated temporal trends and demographic adoption patterns of percutaneous left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO). Among 190,020 weighted procedures, annual volume increased from 4,875 to 60,445. In-hospital mortality was exceptionally low (0.1%). Age-adjusted procedural rates rose from 34.19 to 379.87 per 100,000 population. However, significant disparities persisted, characterized by heavy centralization in urban teaching hospitals (87.0%) and disproportionately lower absolute age-adjusted utilization among female, Black, Hispanic, and Asian/Pacific Islander patients compared to male and White cohorts. Targeted initiatives are needed to ensure equitable access to structural heart interventions.

Life-Threatening Ventricular Tachycardia and Transient Brugada-Like Electrocardiographic Abnormalities Caused by Severe Hyperkalemia Due to Urinary Retention in a 55-Year-Old Man.
summary: BACKGROUND Hyperkalemia is a potentially fatal electrolyte disturbance that typically manifests as progressive conduction abnormalities, bradyarrhythmias, and sine-wave electrocardiographic changes. In rare cases, however, severe hyperkalemia also presents with malignant ventricular tachyarrhythmias and transient electrocardiographic abnormalities involving the right precordial leads, potentially leading to diagnostic confusion with primary arrhythmic disorders. CASE REPORT A 55-year-old man with no known cardiovascular disease presented with palpitations, dyspnea, and diaphoresis. Electrocardiography demonstrated sustained wide-QRS ventricular tachycardia accompanied by hemodynamic instability. Following electrical cardioversion, recurrent ventricular tachyarrhythmias occurred, requiring repeated defibrillation, cardiopulmonary resuscitation, intravenous amiodarone, and mechanical ventilation. Laboratory testing revealed severe hyperkalemia (7.6 mmol/L), profound metabolic acidosis (pH 7.059, HCO₃⁻ 13.8 mmol/L), and advanced renal dysfunction. Serum potassium was confirmed on repeat testing. Subsequent electrocardiography demonstrated marked QRS widening, terminal conduction delay, and transient right precordial ST-segment abnormalities involving leads V1-V2. Intravenous calcium gluconate and sodium bicarbonate rapidly improved the electrocardiographic abnormalities. Continuous hemodiafiltration and bladder catheterization were performed after postrenal acute kidney injury caused by urinary retention was identified. Correction of hyperkalemia together with treatment of metabolic acidosis resulted in complete resolution of the ventricular arrhythmias and electrocardiographic abnormalities without recurrence. No evidence of structural heart disease or persistent myocardial ischemia was identified during subsequent evaluation. CONCLUSIONS This case illustrates that severe hyperkalemia secondary to reversible postrenal acute kidney injury can simultaneously present with malignant ventricular tachyarrhythmia and transient electrocardiographic abnormalities. Recognition of this reversible metabolic condition is essential to avoid diagnostic error and facilitate prompt life-saving treatment.

title: Partial pericardial agenesis presenting with positional palpitations
summary: Abstract Background: Congenital pericardial agenesis is a rare anomaly caused by defective development of the pleuropericardial membrane. Most cases remain clinically silent, but partial defects may predispose to myocardial herniation, coronary compression, or ventricular arrhythmias. Symptomatic presentations are heterogeneous and often non-specific, which contributes to diagnostic delay. Case Presentation: We report the case of a 40-year-old man presenting with intermittent palpitations unrelated to exertion and aggravated by the left lateral decubitus position. Past medical history was unremarkable and patient did not take any chronic medication. Physical examination and laboratory studies, including thyroid function, were innocent. Initial electrocardiography revealed sinus bradycardia with incomplete right bundle branch block and left anterior fascicular block. A 24-hour Holter showed rare polymorphic premature ventricular contractions, and a treadmill stress test was normal. Transthoracic echocardiography demonstrated hypermobility of the apicolateral left ventricular segments and abnormal motion of the right ventricular apex, raising suspicion of pericardial absence. Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging confirmed partial pericardial agenesis involving the apical third of the right ventricular free wall and the apical region of the left ventricle, with reduced systolic excursion and diastolic bulging suggestive of early herniation. No evidence of coronary compression or myocardial ischemia was identified. Given the mild symptom burden and absence of complications, a conservative management plan was adopted. Surveillance consisted of periodic Holter monitoring to assess ventricular ectopy and annual echocardiography to detect potential progression of herniation or development of coronary compression. The patient remains clinically stable with infrequent palpitations and no imaging progression over follow-up. Conclusion: This case illustrates an unusual presentation of partial pericardial agenesis manifesting primarily as positional palpitations. Partial defects may confer a risk of myocardial ischemia or coronary compression and therefore warrant structured long-term monitoring even in minimally symptomatic individuals. Symptom-oriented management, Holter evaluation of ventricular ectopy, and serial imaging are essential to detect evolving herniation or coronary compromise. Increased awareness of this rare entity may facilitate earlier recognition and prevent misdiagnosis.
